# Vendored assets

- `three.module.js`: Three.js r128, downloaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/build/three.module.js`. MIT license: `https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r128/LICENSE`.
- `chart.umd.js`: Chart.js 4.4.7, downloaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.js`. MIT license: `https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/v4.4.7/LICENSE.md`.
- `../css/fonts/space-grotesk-bold.ttf`: Space Grotesk 700 from Google Fonts. SIL Open Font License 1.1: `https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Space+Grotesk`.
- `../css/fonts/inter-regular.ttf`: Inter 400 from Google Fonts. SIL Open Font License 1.1: `https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter`.
- `../css/fonts/jetbrains-mono-regular.ttf`: JetBrains Mono 400 from Google Fonts. SIL Open Font License 1.1: `https://fonts.google.com/specimen/JetBrains+Mono`.

Runtime assets are served from this repository. No third-party asset CDN is required by the frontend.
